question: Does hoisting CPU feature detection out of the stencil row loop reduce completed CPU call cost without changing outputs?
source_change: Resolve AVX2 support once per stencil call. Keep the same row kernels, arithmetic and work partitioning.
conditions: Repeat the committed CPU protocol once after native numerical tests pass. Preserve every baseline and follow-up sample.
interpretation: Inspect each stencil size and thread count. Reduction and histogram are unchanged controls. Timing differences on the shared host do not establish causality by themselves.
acceptance: Retain the simpler dispatch path if correctness passes and measured stencil medians support removal of the repeated detection overhead. Do not extrapolate beyond this host and bounded sample.
gpu: No GPU kernel changes. Original GPU and CPU comparison remains tied to its original source and binary. Do not relabel it as the new CPU baseline.
